description:
Canonical corpus for is_hashtag(dst) and dst_kind(dst). A hashtag destination is the MeshCom FW 4.36 RfC's '#TAG' addressing token carried in the destination field. This corpus exists because all three repos (MCProxy, mc-chat, webapp) independently misclassified a '#'-prefixed destination as a personal DM, which corrupted conversation keying and ack handling. It pins CLASSIFICATION ONLY -- prefix/subscription matching (RfC US-3) is deliberately NOT specified here, because the RfC's stated boundary rule contradicts its own worked examples and is unresolved. See MeshCom-Hashtag-prep.md sections 9.1 and 15.1.

is_hashtag(dst): resolve via-routing (last comma component, stripped), then true iff the target starts with '#', is at least 2 characters, and every character after the '#' is in [A-Za-z0-9-]. Case-insensitive by design: a lowercase tag must still classify as a hashtag, or it falls back into the DM branch -- the exact bug this corpus prevents. Deliberately NOT length-bounded, for the same reason.

dst_kind(dst) resolves via-routing first, then applies these rules IN ORDER:
  1. empty                                   -> 'unknown'
  2. '*' or 'ALL'                            -> 'broadcast'
  3. is_group(target)                        -> 'group'
  4. is_hashtag(target)                      -> 'hashtag'
  5. starts with '#' but is NOT a valid tag  -> 'unknown'   <-- load-bearing
  6. all-ASCII-digit, outside 1..99999       -> 'unknown'
  7. otherwise                               -> 'direct'

Rule 5 is the reason this is a kind function and not a boolean. A malformed '#' destination addresses nobody, and must NOT fall through to 'direct' -- treating it as a personal DM is the original defect, and a malformed tag is exactly the case most likely to arrive from a buggy or hostile sender. 'unknown' means 'do not deliver, do not key a conversation, do not ack'.

vectors.name: hashtag lowercase is still a hashtag
over-long tag still classifies as a hashtag
bare hash is not a destination
via-routed numeric group is not a hashtag
via-routed callsign is not a hashtag
hash in the via path only
comma cannot be part of a tag body
